تمتزجون (form VIII)
# تَمْتَزِجُونَ (tamtazijūna) /tam.ta.zi.d͡ʒuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
# تُمْتَزَجُونَ (tumtazajūna) /tum.ta.za.d͡ʒuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
